description: The answer for one domain name: status, drop day, price today, registry facts, word facts and similar sales. Use it when someone asks about one specific domain name: whether it is open or for sale, what it costs, when it drops. The status `not_checked` means no answer: the name may be taken. Pass `name` (such as get.plumbing).

fields.description: Comma-separated top-level keys to keep: name, ending, tracked, status, lifecycle, drop, ownableNow, price, registry, parking, length, format, shape, word, rating, verdict, value, comps.

name.description: A full domain name on an ending in the catalog, such as harbor.io: lowercase, an internationalized name as punycode. A bare word, a subdomain, an email address or an unknown ending is refused with the reason, and a suggestion when there is one.

name: ud_get_name

endingsSoldOn.description: Endings the word sold on in 12 months.

parking.description: The parking or sale venue id.

status.description: Where the name stands for a buyer. A list row's status reads here as: `resell` is `for_sale` (`at_auction` at a drop-catch venue), `premium` is `free_premium`.

tracked.description: The name is in the catalog.

dataset.description: The GitHub dataset holding the same rows.

details.description: The public Unique.domains page about the subject.

next.description: The next page on the API, when there is one.

meta.description: The day of the answer, and the page cursor of a list.

title: Answer for one domain name
